capability_investigated:
The processor(...) feature-extraction step and generate(features, prompts, ...)
batch interface. Studied what the WhisperFeatureExtractor does with raw audio
and what shapes generate accepts for features and prompts.
what_i_learned:
The feature extractor collapses any-length audio into a single 30s window
(3000 mel frames), so the stub silently deletes everything past 0:30 — a pure
deletion failure on multi-minute calls. It also accepts a list of audio arrays
and stacks them into a [N, 128, 3000] batch, and generate already accepts that
batched tensor with a per-window list of prompts, returning N results.
hypothesis:
Split audio into <=30s windows, run them as one batched generate call, and
join the per-window decodes. This recovers the truncated tail (the dominant
deletion axis) with no new import and a single decode pass within budget.
